self.title: Cycle 14 · Predictive Information and Dissipation Bounds in Nonequilibrium Systems

detail.title: Predictive Information and Dissipation Bounds in Nonequilibrium Systems
detail.summary: This cycle evaluates the theoretical relationship between predictive information and thermodynamic dissipation in nonequilibrium systems with finite or noisy memory, utilizing collected evidence on fluctuation relations and information engines.
